name: aegisheal
description: AegisHeal - Agentic AI-Enabled Autonomous Framework for Intelligent Software Fault Recovery and Resilience

scripts.bootstrap: npm install && node scripts/setup.js && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
